summary: Banco Macro S.A., the Argentine bank whose ADRs are registered as Macro Bank Inc., disclosed via Form 6-K a CNV relevant-event notice that it acquired 21,598 own Class B common shares (Ps$1 par, one vote each) at an average Ps$9,777.136 per share, totaling Ps$211,166,590. The purchases were made under Section 64 of Argentine Law 26,831 and applicable CNV rules, a routine open-market buyback authorization rather than a formal tender offer; no board recommendation, advisor, premium or closing date was stated. Watch for continued buyback disclosures and any resulting free-float or treasury-share overhang affecting arbitrage positioning.
